artifacts.summary: Fixed validate-wiring.sh's missing-context failure attribution (tree label + full resolved path + per-tree counts) and pruned 41 genuinely-dangling entries from .opencode/context/index.json; added both-directions regression fixture; redeployed and verified.

completion_data.completion_summary: Root-caused the 41 Missing context file failures as a message-attribution defect (not a path-resolution bug as hypothesized) plus a genuine stale-data inconsistency in .opencode/context/index.json. Fixed validate_context_files to label every failure/pass line with its deployed tree and full resolved path and emit per-tree missing/total counts, added both-directions regression cases (f)/(g) with a negative-control proof, pruned the 41 dangling .opencode index entries (150 -> 109, all resolving), redeployed, and verified validate-wiring.sh --all passes green with the check still failing loudly on a genuinely absent file.
